name: Aditya Manjrekar
title: Multimodal ML Research
shortBio: MSc Computer Science student at York University researching how multimodal models fail and how to measure it. Previously eight months of production engineering at TD Bank.
longBio: My research looks at where multimodal models break: why an emotion model reads older faces worse, how retrieval systems lose track of their evidence, and when a model should decline to answer. Before research I spent eight months at TD Bank on deployment pipelines, credential security, and an LLM document tool, so I care about results that survive outside a notebook.
